description: Check whether a hotend can keep up: volumetric flow (mm³/s) = layer height × line width × speed, compared against the hotend limit, plus the maximum safe speed. Accepts a hotend preset name (stock, v6, bambu, volcano, rapido, high-flow, goliath…) or an explicit max flow.

hotend.description: Preset: stock, v6, ender3, prusa-mk3, prusa-mk4, bambu, volcano, rapido, dragon-hf, high-flow, chc-pro, goliath, voron

name: calculate_volumetric_flow
title: Volumetric flow / max speed check
